title_en: The Mahdi in the Canonical Hadith Collections of the School of the Companions - Episode 3
description_en: The Mahdi (peace be upon him) in the Canonical Hadith Collections of the School of the Companions - Episode 3, an episode of the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An episode investigating references to the Mahdi within the hadith collections of the school of the Companions.
